links.outcome: Ablation of enhanced RAG components and error analysis of critical errors on medical benchmarks
links.effect: Ablation confirmed synergistic contributions of the innovations, and error analysis showed a substantial reduction in critical errors; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: An ablation study confirms the synergistic contributions of our innovations, and an error analysis highlights a substantial reduction in critical errors, positioning ECRAG-LLM as a more reliable and intelligent solution for resource-constrained clinical environments.

unlisted_practices: Multi-stage instruction tuning on general medical knowledge followed by context-aware and causal reasoning cases
Hybrid retrieval with cross-encoder re-ranking and context summarization for RAG

screen.reason: The paper develops a new clinical RAG-LLM system (ECRAG-LLM) using multi-stage instruction tuning and advanced retrieval and benchmarks it on medical benchmark datasets. Developing and benchmarking a novel model architecture is not testing an organizational deployment practice.
